chapter: The Paradise and life in Queens
title: Auditioning for the Paradise after Jack the Bear Parker
summary: With Tim Kennedy, John Acee and Billy Taylor Jr. he auditioned and got the job when Jack the Bear's contract ended.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah. Let's get down to business on the Paradise now. How did that all come about?

I went in and did an audition and I had...let's see, who'd I have when I auditioned...Tim Kennedy, who was in the Vanguard the other night. I had John Acee, Billy Taylor, Jr., and that was it. And we did the audition. Jack the Bear Parker had the band there before. And I did the audition...
Did you know him, Jack the Bear?
Oh sure. And I got the job.
How did that come down? The person who had the job before, Jack the Bear...
Well, he was leaving, the contract was up or somethin' and they were lookin' for somebody. And that's how I got that.
Is that a place that you had been to very much before?
No, I'd never been in there before. No. Gene Ramey was playin' bass before Pickles...he made the audition, Gene Ramey.
